hints.title: Joining on Shared Followers
hints.text: Join the relations table with itself on follower_id where user1 is strictly less than user2.

hints.title: Counting Common Followers
hints.text: Group by user1_id and user2_id, counting the common followers for each distinct pair.

hints.title: Ranking Pairs by Follower Count
hints.text: Use the rank window function over follower count descending to select all pairs achieving the top rank of 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RankedPairs AS (
    SELECT
        r1.user_id AS user1_id,
        r2.user_id AS user2_id,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r1.follower_id) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM Relations r1
    JOIN Relations r2
        ON r1.follower_id = r2.follower_id
        AND r1.user_id < r2.user_id
    GROUP BY r1.user_id, r2.user_id
)
SELECT
    user1_id,
    user2_id
FROM RankedPairs
WHERE rnk = 1;
```

complexity.time: O(R^2) worst case for self-joining relations on follower_id
complexity.space: O(P) space for grouped user pairs
variables: P: distinct pairs of users with shared followers
complexity.notes: Self-join on follower_id with RANK() window filter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using LIMIT 1 misses ties when multiple user pairs share the maximum number of followers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: RANK() over count descending captures all maximal pairs uniformly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle multiple ties correctly using RANK() or DENSE_RANK().

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def find_pairs(relations: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    m = pd.merge(relations, relations, on='follower_id', suffixes=('_1', '_2'))
    m = m[m['user_id_1'] < m['user_id_2']]
    if m.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=['user1_id', 'user2_id'])
    counts = m.groupby(['user_id_1', 'user_id_2']).size().reset_index(name='common')
    max_c = counts['common'].max()
    res = counts[counts['common'] == max_c][['user_id_1', 'user_id_2']]
    res.rename(columns={'user_id_1': 'user1_id', 'user_id_2': 'user2_id'}, inplace=True)
    return res
solutions.approach: Merge on follower and filter maximum count in pandas
